key_insight: DeepEvidence shifts AI from simply retrieving relevant facts to actively exploring, organizing, and synthesizing scientific evidence. The core breakthrough is an agent that builds explicit representations of evidence to support deeper biomedical discovery.
problem_solved: Biomedical research is no longer limited by data availability; the real bottleneck is making sense of the growing body of evidence. This paper addresses the difficulty of integrating, interpreting, and connecting evidence into usable scientific understanding.
method: Uses a deep research agent that goes beyond search and retrieval.
Constructs explicit representations of scientific evidence rather than returning isolated facts.
Supports evidence exploration and synthesis to help uncover relationships across biomedical sources.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this highlights a move from question-answering systems toward evidence-aware research agents. It suggests a path for building tools that better support scientific reasoning, literature review, and discovery workflows.

paper_title: Shifting from knowledge retrieval to evidence exploration and synthesis
paper_authors: Shruti Shikhare, Jake Cohen-Setton, Krishna C. Bulusu
